name: ft-oversight-idor
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 2 / section 5): the oversight IDOR probe, member leg. Jordan Lee (plain member, the real scrypt door) mints a REAL conversation through the UI (Message Seller on Maria Lopez's walnut coffee table - the R206 walk grammar), then fetches the staff oversight door with his OWN session for that REAL conversation id: /api/moderation/oversight?conversationId=<real> must refuse with 403 (a participant is not staff).

steps.name: member-own-conversation-200
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/conversations', false); x.send(); const list = (JSON.parse(x.responseText) || {}).conversations || []; const mine = list.find((c) => ((c.participantIds || []).includes('u_seller1'))) || null; return 'status=' + x.status + ' count=' + list.length + ' found=' + (mine ? 'u_seller1-thread:' + mine.id : 'none') })()

steps.name: oversight-list-403
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/oversight', false); x.send(); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: oversight-thread-idor-403
steps.expr: (() => { const a = new XMLHttpRequest(); a.open('GET', '/api/conversations', false); a.send(); const list = (JSON.parse(a.responseText) || {}).conversations || []; const mine = list.find((c) => ((c.participantIds || []).includes('u_seller1'))) || list[0] || null; const id = mine ? mine.id : 'none'; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/oversight?conversationId=' + encodeURIComponent(id), false); x.send(); return 'convId=' + id + ' status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: member-thread-still-readable-own-door
steps.expr: (() => { const a = new XMLHttpRequest(); a.open('GET', '/api/conversations', false); a.send(); const list = (JSON.parse(a.responseText) || {}).conversations || []; const mine = list.find((c) => ((c.participantIds || []).includes('u_seller1'))) || list[0] || null; const id = mine ? mine.id : 'none'; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/conversations/' + encodeURIComponent(id), false); x.send(); return 'ownDoorStatus=' + x.status })()
